name: Casino home, logged in
note: Реєстрація is the marker that separates the two auth frames: it is drawn by the logged-out header and by nothing else on this page. Measured against the 2026-09-11 export.

name: Casino home, Слоти chip selected
note: No second frame exists. The Figma file draws the casino home once, with the Слоти chip's neighbour Популярні selected (src/lib/data.ts:49-56), so this row reuses 1:581 and declares variantOf. Wild Cash x9990 was measured rather than reasoned: loaded at 390x844 on 2026-09-12 and read out of document.body.innerText, it is the one line this state renders that the other three category states do not. It is absent from the default page because Нові Ігри cuts at limit: 6 and Space XY occupies a slot until the chip filters it out.

name: Casino home, лайв Казіно chip selected
note: No second frame exists; see casino-slots. Mini Roulette is the only game tagged both crash and live-casino, and measuring the four states on 2026-09-12 confirmed it is the one line unique to this one.

name: Casino home, Краш Ігри chip selected
note: No second frame exists; see casino-slots. This state has NO unique line, measured — every string it renders is rendered by some other category too — so it is pinned by a pair of rejects instead, and the pair was chosen from measurement rather than from the catalogue. Sweet Bonanza is drawn by популярні and слоти and not here; Mega Roulette is drawn by популярні and лайв Казіно and not here; together they exclude all three neighbours. Aviator carries the other half: a reject-only row passes on a blank page, and Aviator is a crash game this state draws. The obvious pair — Wild Cash x9990 and Mini Roulette — would have been VACUOUS against the default page, which renders neither.

name: Sportsbook, logged out
note: Login changes the header and nothing else: the sportsbook body is node-for-node identical to 1:88 (docs/design-inventory/07-sport.md:34).

name: Menu, logged in
note: The Figma layer name ends in a space. Quoted on /dev/screens so the space is visible. The two rejects are what separate this frame from its two neighbours: Реєстрація is drawn only by the logged-out panel and ★ only by the VIP pill 1:6832. Note what is NOT used — the string VIP, which is in all three panels, because every one of them lists a Vip Manager link (MenuPanel.tsx:468). A marker chosen by reading the frame names rather than the rendered text would have picked it.

name: Menu, logged out
note: Figma names this frame postlog; the label lies. Its content is the logged-out panel — two auth buttons, no avatar, no ID, no VIP badge (src/components/panels/MenuPanel.tsx:18, docs/design-inventory/08-menus.md:43).

name: Menu, logged in as VIP
note: Differs from 1:7015 by one node: the orange VIP pill 1:6832 above the username. The header is identical. That one node is the whole difference, so ★ — the pill's own text node, MenuPanel.tsx:251 — is the only thing that proves this row captured the VIP frame and not its twin.

name: Search, empty field with history
note: NO URL REACHES THIS FRAME, so it has never been screenshotted or axe-swept. It needs recent.length > 0: src/store/useAppStore.ts:37 starts recent as [], UrlStateBridge.tsx:46-47 calls setQuery, and setQuery (useAppStore.ts:49) never touches recent — only commitQuery does, and only an interaction calls it. So the Нещодавні запити list is drawn in Figma and unreviewable in the build. A state nobody can link to is a state nobody can review.

name: Search, empty field with no history
note: Opening the panel with an empty recent list renders the empty state, which is this frame — not 1:7363. Captured under the name search-resting until 2026-09-10; renamed because that name pointed at the wrong frame. This row carries rejects and NO expectText, and that gap is measured rather than an oversight: the empty frame is the only one of the four whose content is entirely shared with the others. Its header Провідні провайдери is also drawn on the casino home behind it, and the one string unique to it — the field placeholder Пошук провайдерів... — is an attribute, which no text check reads. So this row proves it is not its three neighbours; it cannot prove the panel opened at all.

name: Search, query with matches
note: prag matches Pragmatic, the first of the five providers this panel searches. Verified in a browser against the static export on 2026-09-11: the panel draws ВІДПОВІДНІ ПРОПОЗИЦІЇ with one row, Pragmatic / 20 ігор / СЛОТИ. Until then the query was bon, and bon matched NOTHING — the panel searches providers, not games (SearchOverlay.tsx:123), and no provider among Pragmatic, 3 Oaks Gaming, BGaming, Nolimit City and Spribe contains it. So this row rendered Провайдерів не знайдено and was the same frame as search-no-results below it, and two of the design's four search states had never been screenshotted or axe-swept. The note that shipped with bon reasoned at length about whether to probe in Latin or Cyrillic and never checked whether the query returned a single hit; expectText below is what makes that impossible to repeat.

name: Search, query with no matches
note: The query is ксзщ, percent-encoded exactly as it goes on the wire. It matches nothing and is Cyrillic on purpose: it is the home row on a Ukrainian keyboard, so it is a string a player could actually produce, and it proves the search survives Cyrillic input at all — the defect src/lib/search.ts was rewritten to fix.
